_how: Outside a house (townhouses and villas, which have a plot): optional pieces the owner, or a decorator they hire, can add. Each is bought once for that home and drawn round the house in 3D (components/home/HomeGrounds.tsx). Saved in the home's style (citizen.homeStyle[tier].exterior), so a decorator's work carries over like the floor and paint.

items.name: Garden
items.desc: A lawn all round, hedges, flower beds and date palms.

items.name: Swimming pool
items.desc: An 8 m pool with a stone deck and two loungers.

items.name: Garage
items.desc: A two-car garage with a roll-up door.

items.name: Driveway & car park
items.desc: Paved driveway with two marked bays and a gate.

items.name: BBQ corner
items.desc: A built-in grill with a table for six.
